title: Jai
extract:
Jai is one of the two type of Link crafting component used to create Zaws in Cetus, and focuses on increasing the Zaw's Attack Speed in exchange for damage.
The initial Jai blueprint can be first acquired after reaching the Rank of Neutral with the Ostron and buying it from Hok for  1,000. Other versions of the Jai are available from Hok after reaching higher ranks and for more Standings.

Overview

The Jai blueprint can be purchased from Hok after reaching the rank of Neutral with the Ostron for  1,000.
